text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 1, 2024) for 22 Weatherstone Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 1, 2024) for 22 Weatherstone Crescent, Folder Number 24 233961 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 20, 2025 and to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
